about.title: About OtakuFusion
about.intro: Anime is loved all around the world, and millions of people search for anime online every month. With so many free anime sites available, not all of them are equally safe or convenient. That’s why we created OtakuFusion — a simple, safe, and enjoyable way for anime fans to watch their favorite series online.
about.s1Text: OtakuFusion is a free platform to watch anime online. You can stream subbed or dubbed episodes in high quality without registration or payment. We keep ads minimal to ensure a smooth and comfortable experience.
about.s2Text: Yes! We carefully monitor ads and site behavior to ensure everything stays safe. If you ever notice anything suspicious, let us know — we’ll fix it quickly.
about.s3Title: 3. Why OtakuFusion is a great choice for anime fans:
about.s3i1: A huge library of popular, classic, and new anime titles.
about.s3i2: Subbed and dubbed versions in multiple languages.
about.s3i6: Works on both desktop and mobile devices.
about.s3i7: Fast support for questions and content requests.
about.outro: If you’re looking for a safe and convenient way to watch anime online, give OtakuFusion a try. If you enjoy it, share it with your friends and bookmark our site!
about.cta: Join us in celebrating the world of anime!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: OtakuFusion is an educational and portfolio project. It is built to demonstrate software engineering skills (UI, APIs, integrations). It is not a commercial product, not sold as a streaming service, and may be incomplete, experimental, or taken offline at any time. This policy describes privacy in that limited context.
privacy.s1Title: 1. What this project is (and is not)
privacy.s1i1: Personal learning, coursework, and/or portfolio use only unless clearly stated otherwise.
privacy.s1i2: No guarantee of availability, accuracy of metadata, or fitness for any particular purpose.
privacy.s1i3: Streaming or third-party integrations, if enabled, are technical demonstrations; their providers have their own terms and privacy policies.
privacy.s2i1: Basic account or authentication data you choose to provide (e.g. email), only if such features exist in the deployed build.
privacy.s2i2: Anonymous or aggregated analytics (e.g. pages viewed, device or browser type) if analytics are enabled.
privacy.s2i3: Cookies or similar technologies needed for sessions, preferences, or analytics.
privacy.s3i1: Operating and improving the demo application.
privacy.s3i2: Debugging, security, and preventing obvious misuse of a non-production deployment.
privacy.s3i3: No sale of personal data as part of this educational project.
privacy.s4Text: The app may call external APIs (for example metadata or media-related endpoints). Those services process data under their own policies. Use of this project does not override their rules.
privacy.s5Text: Cookies may be used for essential functionality and, if configured, analytics. You can restrict cookies in your browser; some features may then not work.
privacy.s6Text: Reasonable care may be taken to protect data, but no method of transmission over the internet is fully secure. A portfolio or student deployment should not be treated like a regulated production platform.
privacy.s7Text: The site may link to external sites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
privacy.s8Text: This project is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children as part of this educational build.
privacy.s9Text: This policy may be updated as the project evolves. The effective date above reflects the latest version shown on this page.
